themes_detail.label: Graffiti Surge Explodes
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints skyrocketed to 22 reports last week—577% above the 8-week baseline of 3.2 weekly complaints—marking the most severe week-to-week spike in district 309 over the past 2 months and signaling either coordinated vandalism or a sudden enforcement gap.
evidence: 22 graffiti complaints last week vs 3.2 weekly baseline over prior 8 weeks (577% increase)
Z-score of 5.43 indicates statistically extreme deviation with high severity classification
Spike appeared suddenly in latest reporting period with no prior warning trend
reporting_angles: Identify hot spots: Are complaints clustered geographically (e.g., specific blocks, transit corridors, park areas)?
Enforcement angle: Has NYPD/Sanitation reduced tagging removal operations or patrols this week?

themes_detail.label: Street Condition Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints jumped to 26 reports last week—225% above the 8-week average of 8.0 per week—suggesting rapid pavement degradation or pothole clustering that may be tied to recent weather or deferred maintenance in Flatbush/PLG.
evidence: 26 street condition complaints last week vs 8.0 weekly baseline (225% increase, z-score 4.1)
Complaints likely tied to winter freeze-thaw cycles or deferred DOT repairs
No recent community board or local media coverage, suggesting this is under-reported
reporting_angles: Ground truth: Map complaint locations and verify pothole/crack severity in person
DOT responsiveness: How long are street repairs taking in this district vs citywide average?

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dogs—Sharp Spike
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints surged to 3 reports last week—1100% above the 8-week baseline of 0.2 per week—indicating a sudden public safety or animal control enforcement issue in this week's data.
evidence: 3 unleashed dog complaints last week vs 0.2 weekly baseline (1100% increase, z-score 6.35)
Extremely low baseline suggests either new reporting behavior or genuine behavioral shift
No corroborating Reddit or local news mentions yet—original reporting opportunity
reporting_angles: Are specific parks or blocks seeing repeat incidents? Interview neighbors and dog owners.
Animal control follow-up: Are 311 complaints being investigated and resolved, or is there a backlog?

themes_detail.label: Water System Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Water system complaints jumped to 36 reports 2 weeks ago—324% above the 8-week baseline of 8.5 per week—suggesting a potential infrastructure failure, main break, or quality issue affecting multiple buildings in the district.
evidence: 36 water system complaints 2 weeks ago vs 8.5 weekly baseline (324% increase, z-score 5.53)
Distinct from plumbing (615 baseline complaints) and water leak (452 baseline), suggesting systemic issue
Timing: Check if spike correlates with known DEP main breaks or water main work in district
reporting_angles: DEP records: Did a water main break, burst, or emergency repair occur 2 weeks ago?
Resident impact: Interview affected buildings about service disruptions, water quality, or pressure issues

themes_detail.label: Asbestos Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints reached 10 reports 3 weeks ago—900% above the 8-week baseline of 1.0 per week—indicating either a major construction/demolition project disturbing asbestos-containing materials or a cluster of deteriorating buildings requiring DOB/EPA investigation.
evidence: 10 asbestos complaints 3 weeks ago vs 1.0 weekly baseline (900% increase, z-score 10.39, highest severity)
355 recent DOB permits filed, including 7 full demolitions that may trigger asbestos exposure
Highest statistical severity score in entire dataset warrants urgent follow-up
reporting_angles: DOB enforcement: Were asbestos abatement protocols followed in recent demolitions or major alterations?
Health impact: Interview residents near complaint locations about respiratory issues or evacuation orders
